description: A Stamford native, Hubert Delany has devoted his life to serving our community and defending our nation. His distinguished military career exemplifies integrity and selfless service, and he has served in missions effecting communities across the world, covering humanitarian disaster relief, the Army's Coronavirus Response, NATO's anti-aggression operations, and International Crises.
